# James R. McCarthy (Jim McCarthy)

> We use AI as a differentiator, to elevate and reinforce the quality of the service. Validation is one of the ways: the work outside gets confirmed, so clients, service partners, and our teams are looking at the same result.

James R. McCarthy (Jim McCarthy): I have the privilege of leading Case FMS, a leading provider of exterior facility maintenance across the United States and Canada, with more than 35,000 client locations. We use AI as a differentiator, to elevate and reinforce the quality of the service. Validation is one of the ways: the work outside gets confirmed, so clients, service partners, and our teams are looking at the same result. He writes about the operating work, the tools, golf with his son, and care at home.
